com.github.miachm.sods

Class SheetImage

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.github.miachm.sods.SheetImage

  • public class SheetImage
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents an image embedded in a Sheet. Images can be anchored to a cell position with an offset and size. This object stores the raw bytes and the layout information used by the writer.

    • Constructor Detail

      • SheetImage

        public SheetImage(byte[] data,
                  java.lang.String mimeType)
        Creates an image from raw bytes and MIME type. The image data is copied on access and stored as-is for serialization into the ODS package.
        Parameters:
        data - The raw image bytes.
        mimeType - The image MIME type (image/png for example).

    • Method Detail

      • getPath

        public java.lang.String getPath()
        Returns the internal path for this image. The path is used inside the ODS package to reference the image entry.
        Returns:
        The path, or null if not assigned.

      • getName

        public java.lang.String getName()
        Returns the image name. Names are used to identify the image object inside the document.
        Returns:
        The image name.

      • getMimeType

        public java.lang.String getMimeType()
        Returns the image MIME type. This value indicates the image encoding, such as "image/png".
        Returns:
        The MIME type.

      • getData

        public byte[] getData()
        Returns a copy of the image bytes. A defensive copy is returned to prevent external modifications.
        Returns:
        The image bytes, or null if unset.

      • getWidth

        public java.lang.String getWidth()
        Returns the image width. This is a serialized size value (for example, "3.5cm") stored for layout.
        Returns:
        The width value.

      • getHeight

        public java.lang.String getHeight()
        Returns the image height. This is a serialized size value (for example, "2.0cm") stored for layout.
        Returns:
        The height value.

      • getX

        public java.lang.String getX()
        Returns the X position. This is the horizontal offset from the anchor cell.
        Returns:
        The X position value.

      • getY

        public java.lang.String getY()
        Returns the Y position. This is the vertical offset from the anchor cell.

        The Y position value.

        The anchor row.
